# Number of Sessions per Month

This report shows how the total number of sessions changes each month.

```{r}
# Load your CSV file
sessions <- read.csv("NumberSessionMonth.csv")

# Load ggplot2
library(ggplot2)

# Convert year and month to a full date (add "-01" as the day)
sessions$Month <- as.Date(paste0(sessions$Month, "-01"), format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Basic line plot with trend line
ggplot(sessions, aes(x = Month, y = TotalSessions)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "darkred", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Number of Sessions per Month",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Total Sessions") +
  theme_minimal()
```
